svg.aria-label: martin cp --mode bulk in two phases: read and render into sorted runs, then merge, encode and write tiles in order
svg.title: martin cp --mode bulk in two phases: read and render into sorted runs, then merge, encode and write tiles in order
svg.text: every sort buffer spilled: phase 2 starts

g.text: when workers fall behind, the bounded queue stalls the readers
each worker renders every zoom of each feature into its own sort buffer, spilling sorted runs
after the last spill, one merge streams every run back in tile order
tiles are encoded in parallel and written in the order the archive stores them
